statements.sql: SELECT version, operation FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 2

UPDATE workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs SET content = substr(content, 1, char_length(content) - 1) WHERE source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND path = 'docs/index.md' AND endswith(content, ' ') AND sha2(content, 256) <> content_sha256
DELETE FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs WHERE source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND ingest_run_id = 'm1-dup-test'

SELECT count(*) AS docs, count(DISTINCT path) AS paths, count_if(sha2(content, 256) <> content_sha256) AS hash_mismatches, count_if(octet_length(content) <> size_bytes) AS size_mismatches FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.bronze_docs WHERE source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0'
